title: Share of 2011 ward population recorded as Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe
shows: Quintiles of (P_SC + P_ST) / TOT_P by 144 wards; existing (red) and proposed (amber) camera sites, circle size 0.1 + 0.40 x camera_count mm
method: scst_share = (census2011_P_SC + census2011_P_ST) / census2011_TOT_P; five quantile classes (type-7)
notes: Lowest class drawn at 10% alpha (125,139,143,26) over the basemap; legend shows 3-decimal breaks.

title: 2011 ward total population, shaded by quintile
shows: Quintiles of census2011_TOT_P by 144 wards; existing (red) and proposed (amber) camera sites, circle size 0.1 + 0.40 x camera_count mm
notes: Lowest class drawn at 10% alpha (125,139,143,26) over the basemap; legend shows breaks rounded to whole people.

title: Camera share relative to population share
shows: Ward share of tender-recorded cameras divided by its share of 2011 ward population; no camera points drawn
method: (cam_all / sum(cam_all)) / (census2011_TOT_P / sum(census2011_TOT_P)); cam_all = coalesce(camera_count_sum,0) + coalesce(camera_count_sum_2,0); five fixed classes
notes: Current Map 3; population-share ratio, not density. The filename is historical. Maximum ratio 5.39; fixed classes hold 33/53/40/11/7 wards; 18 wards above 2, 33 below 0.5, 23 of the 29 Q5 wards between 0.5 and 2. Two wards (92, 114) have zero cameras.
